name: playground-template

scripts.publish:summit: playground deploy --env paseo-next --no-build --buildDir dist --domain playground-template --signer dev --suri "$MNEMONIC" --no-contracts --playground --moddable --tag utility

_comment_local_storage: @parity/product-sdk-local-storage is the successor to @parity/product-sdk-storage (same host+browser key-value backend; the API was renamed too, createKvStore/KvStore -> createLocalKvStore/LocalKvStore, so it is not a drop-in for old snippets). It is unused by src/ on purpose — it ships ready for apps built on this template. Pinned EXACTLY, no caret, like host, signer, chain-client, keys and tx: these packages pin product-sdk-host to a single exact version each, in lockstep, and npm's caret on a 0.x range would resolve the next patch, which pins host 0.29 -> truapi 0.26. 0.3.19 is the build that pins host 0.28.0, matching the top-level host and keeping the whole tree on the single truapi 0.25. Bump these only together, and re-check the wire.
_comment_overrides: @polkadot-api/json-rpc-provider override is a workaround for an upstream packaging bug (mirrors what product-sdk's monorepo does). The Host API is @parity/truapi, pulled in transitively via product-sdk-host; app code imports the host types/helpers from @parity/product-sdk-host, which re-exports them from @parity/truapi. product-sdk-host@0.28 pins truapi ^0.25 (codec 3), so the host container must speak truapi 0.25 as well (if connect hangs on 'Polkadot host is not ready', check the host build's truapi version before pinning packages back). ws pinned ^8.21.0 to clear GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p (DoS) in transitive smoldot/@polkadot deps; drop once upstream ranges move past it. Both overrides are duplicated under `pnpm.overrides` because pnpm ignores npm's top-level `overrides` — without the copy, `pnpm install` resolves ws@8.20.0 and the CVE stays open for forks that use pnpm.
